Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Lyell Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4499]Custom npc Lyell[/url] mod Character Lyell (with Hebe and Rosewell), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. asked by breatemata.

*Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Lyell mod (some where in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder)
Drag the [b]"[CP] Lyell"[/b] folder from my Zip into the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder to overwrite the [b]"[CP] Lyell"[/b] folder in it.

This mod replaces the[b] "Canon"[/b] portrait of Lyell.
If the portraits are not showing, please change Lyells's portrait to Canon in the config menu, or open your config.json with a notepad and edit the [b]"LyellVariantPortraits"[/b] line to [b]"LyellVariantPortraits": "Canon"[/b].



23/08/2021: Uploaded content Patcher version.
I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file doesn't work for you, try this version.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4499]Custom npc Lyell[/url]﻿ mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4499]Custom npc Lyell[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]fellowclown[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
